title: Thirty-First Of January
mood: frantic and deadpan, a deadline closing in
subject: filing your tax return online at twenty to midnight on deadline night
caption: Hard techno in the current festival style. A distorted rumble kick on every beat with a continuous saturated sub-rumble filling the space between hits; off-beat open hi-hats; metallic industrial percussion clanking on sixteenths; a squelching acid 303 line opening up through a slow filter sweep; a hoover rave stab and snare-roll builds before each drop. Dark, loud and pressurised, a narrow mono low end, the kick and voice forward, percussion wide. Male voice, low and dry, close to the mic, chanting short repeated phrases in time and half-whispering the countdown, almost no melody. 150 BPM, F minor. Frantic and deadpan, a deadline closing in. No melodic arpeggios, no sung pop chorus, no trance pads, no hardstyle reverse-bass kick, no gabber, no autotune, no breakbeats, no sampled voices.
lyrics:
[Intro - rumble kick and off-beat hats, short]

[Verse 1 - chanted]
Eleven forty, thirty-first of January
Gateway password, wrong again
Reset link, check your inbox
Reset link, check your spam

[Pre-Chorus - half-whispered over a snare-roll build]
Twenty minutes
Find the receipts

[Chorus - chanted]
Box eleven, box eleven
What goes in box eleven
Hundred pound fine at midnight
Box eleven

[Drop - rumble kick, acid line and hoover stab, no vocals]

[Verse 2 - chanted]
Shoebox on the kitchen floor
Train ticket, train ticket, sausage roll
Mileage on a napkin
Did I go to Swindon? Did I go to Swindon?

[Pre-Chorus - half-whispered over a snare-roll build]
Eleven fifty-eight
Submit

[Chorus - chanted]
Box eleven, box eleven
Spinning wheel, don't refresh
Eleven fifty-nine and fifty seconds
Submitted

[Outro - kick drops out, acid line alone]
Reference number, write it down
See you next January
